title: Implementer has no way to remove a file it created by mistake

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Observed 2026-11-12 (slicer s451, ork-20261111-213809-6e14): the implementer left a 2-byte scratch file tests/test_merge_slice.py.tail, which turned affected.py red; it had no rm in its allowlist, so the run paused for the owner, and the outer session deleted it. Wanted: let the implementer delete untracked files it created this run (or git rm/git clean -n style scoped to its own worktree), or have ork's round check name untracked stray files before red.
